transcription: My wife found an old condom wrapping paper from when we were a young couple in my clothes, but she thought it was new and I was cheating. So, this is kind of a funny story that was very traumatizing for both of us when it was fresh. Long read ahead for this story and need to add more context. My wife and I have been boyfriend and girlfriend for around five to six years before marrying. We are now married for almost three years. I am a medical doctor and often wear lab coats as part of the medical uniform in almost every place I've worked or been internov. So logically I have like around eight to ten lab coats from since I was studying medicine. We became a couple just before starting medical school. We used to have sex and used condoms very early in our relationship, using a black wrapping seco brand ones. I usually hid those in my drawer on my room when I lived back with my family when she and I were just BFGF. When we got married I moved most of my clothing to our new place, leaving some unimportant stuff back in my family's home that I thought I would get back later. She did the same and we moved in together. This story happened around two to three months after marrying. I was doing my rotation on family medicine on a clinic in downtown. I remember that day I had to stop in a general store to buy some face masks since I did not have any and it was covid times, so I bought some black star wars face masks and went on with my day. I reached home and my wife was doing laundry, I left upstairs to change and then go and do stuff together. After a few minutes my wife does the most horrible screaming I have probably ever heard from her, she comes upstairs crying and screaming, I was absolutely terrified. She meets me in our room and says, what the EFF is this? And shows me a tiny corner of what seems as a condom wrapper. Ha, looks like a condom wrapper, I said, it was in one of your lab coats, I just found IT. She was using the implant contraceptive for around three years, so we were not using any condom since those three years. My blood turned cold because of several reasons one. I actually had no idea of how that got there. Two, how could I express that without sounding like a liar or a manipulative person? She was absolutely livid rightfully of course. I just went quiet, sat down and did a long think, I think it is a face mask wrapping, I had to buy one today and it was black too, I said. She did not believe me, was crying her heart out and was very emotional. I offered her to take her to that general store where I bought the face mask, she agreed. It has been the longest car ride we have ever had, we were both completely silent and I was just extremely confused. We reached the general store, it was not the same wrapping at all, the one she found was way smaller. She cried even more and yelled at me in the curb. I examined the wrapper with more detail and I thought you could read some small letters in the wrapping, Siko. It then came to me that it was probably one of our old condom wrappers and I expressed it to her, let's buy one then, she said. We bought one into my horror it was a different shade of black, it had a slightly different design overall. All hope was lost, she asked me to drive her back home and she would leave with our pets and belongings to her parents house. I was absolutely devastated and frustrated, I really thought it was all over. We were driving back home and then. IT clicked so this is the real explanation a few days back my parents said that they had some old lab coats that I left at their house when I moved in with my wife to our current home. I met up with my dad to retrieve them, I got them and when I reached home I put them in the dirty clothes bag to clean them before using them again. That lab coat contained that wrapping, since it was a very old lab coat that I had since my student years. I explained very excited to my wife, which seemed way common since she knew that the lab coat was very old and it was recently handed to me for my family's home where we had the condoms. She was not totally over it, so the next day we went to my parents house to see if a condom was still there and voila, the wrapping was exact. Turns out that the design was changed two years back, so the wrapping only matched the condoms design before.
